governance.attested_by: nyiso-56 measured-zonal-load keeper promotion 2026-07-07 (owner decision: 'if it's better promote it'; G-20c)
governance.note: The nyiso-53 li-tsl keeper recipe VERBATIM (nyiso-41 meta at HEAD + PR-#1442 re-derived floors + measured downstate CT citygate premium + nyiso_li_lcr_tsl #1345 + use_plant_emission_rates_v2 + energy_reserve_coopt) with exactly ONE change, and it is a MEASURED-DATA change, not a tuned parameter (rule 12, no new free parameter — the DOF ledger is byte-identical to nyiso-53's): the energy LP now dispatches on the MEASURED per-zone hourly load shapes (NYISO OASIS 'pal' actual-load, upload U3) instead of the static Gold-Book load shares. Root cause (G-20c): eia_loader.load_zonal_shares read the measured hourly shares only from the curated clean parquet, which is derived + gitignored and therefore absent in a fresh clone, so every zone silently fell back to its static share (NYC 0.28 / LI 0.12, all zones peaking the same hour). The fix adds a raw-file fallback (parse the raw zone-specific-demand file via the canonical curate parsers when the clean parquet is absent). Measured shares put materially more load downstate at the peak (NYC 0.34, LI 0.17) and decorrelate the zone peaks, so the import-constrained NYC/SENY pocket now tightens in the real tight hours. Nothing is fitted to a price residual; the shares are a forward-reproducible physical input (rule 13).
governance.residuals_note: RESULT (G-20c): with measured load the downstate pocket BINDS and the in-LP locational reserve co-optimization (energy_reserve_coopt, 7 locational families) fires — 2023 NYC/Hudson LBMP reaches $1,684/MWh while Upstate maxes at $152/MWh (genuinely locational, exactly the thesis of docs/nyiso-rcpf-overlay.md). vs the nyiso-53 keeper (identical recipe, static shares): C3a mean bias 2023 -9.0%->+1.6% (vs DA; RT now on-target), 2024/25 -10.9/-10.6% -> -7.7/-7.5%; C3b NRMSE 0.182/0.221/0.190 -> 0.188/0.200/0.165 (2024/25 improve, 2023 +0.006); C3c RT tail 2023 0h->21h (actual 10h), 2025 7h->14h (actual 42h). C1 fuel-mix 14/14 PASS, C2 PASS, C4 PASS, C7 PASS — no load-bearing regression; the run dominates nyiso-53 on both structural faithfulness (measured>static, rule 12; real locational binding) and price level/shape. C8 ST_GAS forced-energy breach PERSISTS but at a LOWER share than the keeper (30.5/44.6/38.2% vs the keeper's 60.8/69.8/59.7%): measured downstate load lets more of the NYC/LI steam base clear economically, so less is floor-forced. The residual ST_GAS forcing is the same owner-adjudicated LEGITIMATE reliability commitment as nyiso-53's G-05 determination (downstate steamers' persistent 24h base; DARU/SRE + steam min-run; kept+disclosed, rule 1). C3c FAILs only the DA-EXPRESSIBLE gate (DA actual 1h in 2023) — the G-20a scoring-basis artifact: the model produces a real RT-settlement tail (co-opt reserve duals into the LBMP) that is scored against the near-flat DA actual. On the RT basis the tail is a large IMPROVEMENT toward actual, not an over-fire, and nothing was manufactured by curve steepening or offer adders (rules 11/26). OPEN: 2024 (a mild year) and the 2025 DEEP (>$300) tail stay under — the remaining perfect-foresight downstate import over-service; the identified next lever is downstate import discipline (the MEASURED NYC locality import limit is 2,875 MW, curated capacity-deliverability, vs the model's 3,900 MW Dunwoodie-South energy-TTC estimate; apply in-window like the Zone-K TSL #1345). #1344 in-LP condition-varying requirement remains data-blocked (Ask-B).

_open_items: (1) 2024 (mild year) + 2025 DEEP (>$300) price tail still under actual — next structural lever is downstate import discipline: the MEASURED NYC locality import limit is 2,875 MW (capacity-deliverability) vs the model's 3,900 MW Dunwoodie-South energy-TTC estimate; apply in the summer-peak window as the Zone-K TSL (#1345) does for LI. (2) #1344 reserve-scarcity condition-varying requirement — data-blocked on the Ask-B series; the in-LP channel (nyiso_dynamic_reserve_requirements) is built, default-off. (3) SENY 30-min reserve MW requirement remains a placeholder (NYC 1,000/500 and SENY=zones G-K confirmed against primary; the RS4/Locational-Reserve-Requirements PDF is unfetchable in this environment). (4) C3c is scored on the DA-expressible basis (G-20a) — the RT tail the model now produces is not credited by C3c until the settlement-price scoring lands. (5) capacity-deliverability + zonal-shares clean partitions are gitignored; zonal-shares now has a raw fallback, capacity-deliverability still requires curation before a solve.
